title: Fine-grained components
summary: Build a SolidJS component that reads props through the props object so updates stay live.

scenario.briefing: A campus storefront renders a product card. The card must keep the live props binding instead of taking a snapshot of the first value.

objectives.description: Apply the taught syntax in a working file.

hints: Keep the props parameter in the function signature.
Read props.name inside JSX instead of copying it into a local variable.
Return an article with a heading and a paragraph.

misconceptions.feedback: Destructuring reads each getter once and loses the live binding. Read properties through props in JSX.
misconceptions.testDescription: The component keeps props as a live object.

misconceptions.description: Copying a prop into a local value and rendering the copy.
misconceptions.feedback: A local copy is a snapshot. Keep the prop read inside the reactive expression.
misconceptions.diagnostic: A local copy evaluates the prop getter once and never sees later parent updates.

misconceptions.description: Believing destructuring preserves live prop updates.
misconceptions.feedback: Destructuring calls each prop getter once. Read through the props object inside the reactive expression.

sections.title: Components run once
sections.body: A Solid component function runs once to create DOM nodes and reactive bindings. It does not re-run when data changes, so values that must update need to stay behind a getter.

sections.title: Read props through the object
sections.body: Solid props are reactive getters. Reading props.name inside JSX keeps the binding live; destructuring evaluates the getter once and captures a snapshot.

sections.title: Fine-grained updates
sections.body: Only the DOM expressions that read a changed signal update. This removes the need for a virtual DOM diff.

vocabulary.definition: A model where individual computations and DOM nodes subscribe directly to the values they read.
The reactive object a parent passes to a child component.
The build step that turns JSX into direct DOM creation and update code.
